name: H5N1 bird flu
summary: Oregon confirmed a mild H5 case linked to a dairy herd on 19 Nov; no human-to-human spread
state: Oregon Health Authority confirmed on 19 Nov the state's first human H5 bird flu case of 2026, a person with mild symptoms linked to a Morrow County dairy outbreak (OHA). ECDC's 3 Nov update recorded two more dairy-linked cases in Yakima County, Washington, one fatal, with all cases linked to animal exposure (ECDC). Cases remain sporadic, so the level stays Normal; the trend is rising.
for_you: Risk to the public is low. People who work with poultry or dairy cattle should follow public health guidance on protective equipment.

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
drivers: Human cases, mammal-to-mammal spread, mutations, surveillance.
